    Profile

    Our Craft

    The Art of Brewing

    Every bottle of BeyondBrews follows a sacred process—a careful dance of nature, time, and craft. From sourcing the finest organic tea to the final bottling, we ensure every step preserves the integrity and quality of our kombucha.

    Sourcing Organic Tea

    Sourcing Organic Tea

    We source only the finest organic tea leaves from sustainable farms around the world. Each tea variety is carefully selected for its unique flavor profile and health benefits.

    • Certified organic tea leaves
    • Sustainable farming practices
    • Direct trade partnerships
    • Seasonal harvesting

    The SCOBY Cultivation

    The SCOBY Cultivation

    Our symbiotic culture of bacteria and yeast has been nurtured for over a decade. Each batch starts with a small portion of our original SCOBY to maintain consistency.

    • 10+ year old SCOBY lineage
    • Controlled cultivation environment
    • Regular testing for purity
    • Organic sugar feeding

    Precision Brewing

    Precision Brewing

    The tea is brewed at specific temperatures to extract the optimal flavors and nutrients. We use filtered water and precise timing to ensure consistency.

    • Temperature controlled brewing
    • Filtered spring water
    • Exact timing for each tea type
    • Batch-specific brewing notes

    Sweetening & Flavoring

    Sweetening & Flavoring

    We add organic cane sugar and natural flavors to the brewed tea. Our flavorings are derived from real fruits, herbs, and spices.

    • Organic cane sugar
    • 100% natural flavors
    • No artificial sweeteners
    • Fresh, seasonal ingredients

    Fermentation Process

    Fermentation Process

    14-21 days of patient fermentation to develop complex flavors and living probiotics. Each batch is monitored daily for optimal conditions.

    • 14-21 day fermentation cycle
    • Temperature and pH monitoring
    • Daily taste testing
    • Natural carbonation development

    First Fermentation

    First Fermentation

    The initial fermentation phase where the SCOBY consumes the sugar and produces alcohol and acetic acid. This creates the base kombucha.

    • Aerobic fermentation
    • Sugar conversion
    • Alcohol and acetic acid production
    • Probiotic development

    Second Fermentation

    Second Fermentation

    The secondary fermentation phase where additional flavors are added and carbonation is developed. This takes place in sealed bottles.

    • Anaerobic fermentation
    • Flavor infusion
    • Carbonation development
    • Bottle conditioning

    Quality Control

    Quality Control

    Each batch undergoes rigorous quality control testing to ensure consistency, safety, and flavor. We test for pH, sugar content, and microbial balance.

    • pH testing
    • Sugar content analysis
    • Microbial balance testing
    • Sensory evaluation

    Bottling & Packaging

    Bottling & Packaging

    Each bottle is hand-crafted in small batches to ensure quality and consistency. We use glass bottles to preserve the flavor and carbonation.

    • Small batch bottling
    • Glass bottle packaging
    • Hand-labeling
    • Batch coding

    Our Values

    What Makes Us Different

    At BeyondBrews, we're committed to sustainability, quality, and transparency. Every decision we make reflects our dedication to producing the best kombucha while caring for our planet.

    Organic & Sustainable

    We source only organic, sustainably grown ingredients from trusted farmers who share our values.

    Handcrafted Quality

    Each batch is carefully brewed, monitored, and bottled by hand to ensure the highest quality.

    Community Focused

    We believe in supporting local communities and giving back through sustainable business practices.

    Experience the Difference

    Try our handcrafted kombucha and taste the difference that quality, care, and tradition make.
